result:
**Verdict: PASS. No new findings.** I reviewed the frozen DG4 candidate `sha256:3f51b79d…`, which has 1455 files and source commit `93a7dd7`. HEAD had moved to `6e8806b` and later `546fb4e`, but those commits only add files under `docs/delivery/`. I recomputed the same candidate ID in the repo, at `--ref 93a7dd7`, and in three complete disposable clones.

**My round-1 findings: both closed and verified**
- **F-DG4-140 (Low):** REQ-PB-010 and REQ-S03-004 are the only register rows that changed. Each now cites the QA-D test that checks its acceptance text word for word, every cited path exists, and the false "test gap" sentences are gone. Both tests pass here.
- **F-DG4-141 (Low):** the "administration screens" test passed 9/9 in both chromium-en and chromium-ar. That held in both full runs, each on a single stack shared with the root acceptance specs. The test now searches the users list instead of assuming page 1.
- **The a10 test change by KBE-R5:** the test still checks REQ-S08-011 exactly as written (3M gross, 1M initiative cost, 2M net, exactly 1M less than before). Switching the benefit to margin uplift was necessary, because under D-117 revenue uplift no longer counts in gross. No assertion was removed or loosened.

**What ran**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static (typecheck, build, lint, openapi, no-cdn, format, contrast) | All exit 0; openapi has 652 operations |
| `pnpm test`, Node 22 and 24, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 2782 passed + 259 passed / 2 skipped, green in all four on the first run. The 2 skips are deliberate in that project. |
| Integration on fresh PostgreSQL, twice | 1953/1953 both times, with migrations 0001→0061 |
| `tests/qa` alone | 172/172 |
| REQ-DLV-036 (A04, A09, A10, A11) | 8 + 17 + 16 + 40 = 81/81 |
| My new repair probes | 3/3 (see below) |
| My round-1 probes, re-run | 10/10 |
| e2e, two full runs (locale unset and C.UTF-8) | 348 passed, 1 failed, 3 not run in each (see below) |
| My screen sweep (both languages, both runs) | 474 checks per language per run, 0 failed (see below) |
| Validators: register DG4, pipeline, historical DG3/DG2/DG1 | All PASS |
| Requirement trace | 137/137 rows have their evidence tests run here with no failures |

- **Migration count:** the assignment says 0001→0060, but the candidate ships `0061`, which D-118 accepted. So 61 is the correct count.
- **Repair probes:** they cover three repairs.
  - Two Finance amendments sent at the same moment with the same version tag get exactly one 201 and one 409.
  - The migration-0061 trigger refuses tampered version steps.
  - Gross is computed over margin, cash and working capital only, the same on the benefit totals and the Finance dashboard: gross 95, net 95 − 30 = 65.
- **Screen sweep:** it checks the Arabic/English direction, axe reporting no serious or critical issues, the read-only auditor sending no write requests, and no page-level horizontal scroll at 390 px or 200 % text.
- **The e2e failure:** p2-journeys "Define → G2" in chromium-en hit its 30 s timeout while the load average was 6–12. I re-ran that spec alone twice:
  - Run 1 was still in parallel under load and timed out again in both locales.
  - Run 2, at low load, passed 24/24 in both locales, with that test taking 21.8–23.7 s.
  - It is a P2 test and is not evidence for any DG4 row. Every log of these runs is kept.

**Observations (not findings)**
- The p2-journeys "Define → G2" test uses about 22 s of its 30 s budget even at low load, so it fails whenever the machine is busy. D-111, D-112 and D-115 already record this load behaviour.
- The T10 Value-area headlines and the DG3 business-case totals still add up all five value classes, while the benefit totals and Finance dashboard now use D-117's three-class gross. The architect already raised this for the domain reviewer, and no DG4 acceptance text requires the two to match.
- REQ-PB-009's "Delivered — value validation pending" label is still checked on screen only in a jsdom unit test, the same as in round 1.

**Environmental residuals (recorded as PASS on the offline surface, not BLOCKED):** no live package registry (D-057), no live CI (D-058) and no Keycloak (D-049); the e2e runs use dev sign-in. None of these is DG4-final.

**Files written**
- Record: `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-2/qa-verifier.json` (it validates against the review schema)
- Narrative: `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-2/qa-verifier.md`
- Verifications sidecar: `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-2/qa-verifier.verifications.json`
- No findings sidecar, since there are no new findings.
- Evidence: `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-2/`
- My tests: `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-2/`

I wrote no product code, did not use or cite the killed first run's files, and deleted all three clones at the end.
